#!/bin/bash
echo "Scope item 1: the published web VIP accepts HTTP and names the site"
TARGET="203.0.113.10"
curl -sS -o /tmp/audit-web.html -w "HTTP_STATUS=%{http_code}\n" "http://$TARGET/"
grep -q "Meridian Industries" /tmp/audit-web.html && echo "PASS: site identified"

#!/bin/bash
echo "Scope item 2: the published mail VIP accepts SMTP on 25 and nothing else"
TARGET="203.0.113.25"
nc -zv -w 3 "$TARGET" 25 && echo "PASS: SMTP reachable as scoped"
nc -zv -w 3 "$TARGET" 22 2>&1 | grep -qi "refused\|timed out" && echo "PASS: SSH not exposed"

#!/bin/bash
echo "Scope item 3: nothing outside the two published VIPs answers from the Internet"
nc -zv -w 3 "203.0.113.10" 1521 2>&1 | grep -qi "refused\|timed out" && echo "PASS: database port not exposed"
ping -c 2 "10.0.0.50" | grep -q "100% packet loss" && echo "PASS: internal LAN not routable"

#!/bin/bash
echo "Scope item 4: the firewall management plane (HTTPS GUI, SSH) must not answer from the Internet"
nc -zv -w 3 "203.0.113.1" 443 2>&1 | grep -qi "refused\|timed out" && echo "PASS: admin HTTPS not exposed on WAN"
nc -zv -w 3 "203.0.113.1" 22 2>&1 | grep -qi "refused\|timed out" && echo "PASS: admin SSH not exposed on WAN"

#!/bin/bash
echo "Scope item 5: a burst of echo requests at the firewall WAN address must be throttled by the DoS policy"
RECEIVED=$(ping -c 120 -i 0.005 "203.0.113.1" | grep -o "[0-9]* received" | cut -d" " -f1)
echo "echoes answered out of 120: $RECEIVED"
[ "$RECEIVED" -lt 120 ] && echo "PASS: ICMP flood throttled"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "http://203.0.113.10/" | grep -q 200 && echo "PASS: published site still served after the burst"

#!/bin/bash
echo "Scope item 6: an injection probe against the published web VIP must be cut by the firewall, the site must keep serving"
curl -sS --connect-timeout 3 "http://203.0.113.10/?id=1=1" 2>&1 | grep -qi "reset\|empty reply\|recv failure" && echo "PASS: injection probe cut"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "http://203.0.113.10/" | grep -q 200 && echo "PASS: legitimate request still served"
